original_test_intent: Verify the canonical SMBIOS Type 3 Boot-up State value for the intended enclosure matches the approved normal-status enumeration and remains correct after reboot. `System Enclosure or Chassis Status` is the field-group description, not a second independent status field.
original_method: Capture full Type 3 records, select the enclosure by serial/asset/type/BOM identity, parse its raw and decoded Boot-up State enumeration, compare with the approved baseline, perform the approved reboot and repeat without injecting a boot fault.
manual_activity: A user approves the canonical mapping, expected Boot-up State and reboot plan. Metadata extraction, enum comparison and persistence checking are automatable.
required_inputs: Approved mapping from source hierarchy to canonical Boot-up State
safety_requirements: Read SMBIOS only; this case does not authorize power removal, boot-failure injection or firmware changes.
Preserve full Type 3 output and raw enum; do not run the concatenated phrase grep as authoritative.
Do not invent a separate generic Chassis Status field or confuse Boot-up State with Power Supply, Thermal or Security Status.
Reject reserved/out-of-range enums and wrong-enclosure selection.
Stop on ambiguity, drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect all Type 3 structures, select the enclosure, extract canonical Boot-up State and compare raw/decoded values before and after reboot.
Do not inject a fault, modify DMI or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve canonical field semantics, expected normal-state enum and enclosure mapping.
Decide any separate fault-injection coverage and issue the verdict for this metadata case.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not applicable as written because the descriptive concatenation is not the decoded label; it also hides errors, loses record/enum provenance and assumes insecure transport.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Preserve the original wording, archive full Type 3 output/tool/errors and parse record-scoped canonical `Boot-up State` with its raw enum.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The exact source hierarchy, Type 3 script and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Treat the item text as a hierarchy naming the Type 3 Boot-up State member, compare its raw enumeration and decoded label for the mapped enclosure, and retain pre/post-reboot evidence without fault stimulus.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, dmidecode, BIOS and chassis/BOM revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 3 System Enclosure or Chassis States enumeration and installed dmidecode documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Corrects field extraction and avoids inventing a second status while preserving the source text and metadata scope.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; active fault behavior remains separate coverage.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Expected Boot-up State enum and enclosure mapping.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: This firmware-reported status does not prove behavior under an induced boot fault.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve the expected normal Boot-up State for its enclosure and an explicit supported unknown state, but must retain raw enum evidence and cannot add unapproved fault stimuli.
expected_evidence: Approval, canonical mapping, expected Boot-up State enum, enclosure mapping and tool/SMBIOS versions
Complete pre-reboot Type 3 record plus raw/decoded Boot-up State comparison
Engineer verdict and any separate fault-test reference

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Neighboring Type 3 status items and standard field grouping make the hierarchy unambiguous: the target is Boot-up State, not two competing operations.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The canonical field is identifiable and safe to read; expected enum and mapping affect readiness only.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects the literal concatenated filter while retaining read-only Type 3 intent.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps metadata-only safety and recovery but corrects both the field model and automation classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Explicitly defines the item as one canonical state member, preserves raw enum provenance and separates fault-injection coverage.

review_improvement: Prevents empty evidence, invented dual-field acceptance and any unapproved escalation from metadata validation to boot-fault injection.
independent_technical_reasoning: The test is a read/compare/reboot persistence check for one Type 3 enum; after baseline approval, every core action is software-controlled.
